sits low in the foreground, its shape nearly swallowed by shadow at the beginning, then clarifies as it eases forward toward the viewer. The tunnel walls recede in layered bands of concrete and shadow; overhead fixtures are sparse and dim. The motion is steady and deliberate rather than hurried: the chassis settles, the wheels roll with a slight side-to-side correction, and the front end grows larger in frame as it leaves the deep dark behind.
